name: identity-bridge
description: A stateless identity bridge: RFC 8693 token exchange, a JWKS and signed lifecycle events for products

scripts.typecheck: wrangler types && tsc --noEmit -p . && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p test && tsc --noEmit -p test/node && tsc --noEmit -p packages/client && tsc --noEmit -p packages/client/test && tsc --noEmit -p packages/server && tsc --noEmit -p packages/server/test
scripts.build: wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist && npm run build:node && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
